hook.text: Count the blue hoodie's jumps. Bet you get it wrong.

stop.text: Stop! How many did you count?

penguin.text: But did you notice the penguin?

sky.text: Or the sky turning from purple to orange?

swap.text: Or that one of the rope turners got swapped?

spot.text: Attention works like a spotlight. Whatever falls outside it can slip right past you.

study.text: In a famous 1999 study, about half the people counting basketball passes missed a person in a gorilla suit.

ask.text: How many tricks did you catch? Zero to three. Tell me in the comments.
